Outstanding service
before, during, and after the sale.
From planning to planting through storage and transportation, we are here to help you. Give us the opportunity to earn your business.
Feed
We carry and can special order any of the Hubbard Feeds products. Visit their website to explore the wide variety of feed products or give us a call and let us help you find the right feed for your particular needs.
Embden Grain has long been a leader in Hubbard Feeds sales, receiving the Hubbard Feed Inc. Feed Frontiers Dealer Award “Top Pet & Specialty (Equine) Leader” award in 2008, 2009, 2010, and 2011.
We strive for outstanding service before, during and after the sale. From planning to planting through storage and transportation, we are here to help you. Give us the opportunity to earn your business.
Seed
With a wide variety of available options, we carry exceptional brands of seed to serve your needs.
Integra’s role is to identify, test, assemble and deliver seed components together with comprehensive crop production knowledge. Our relationships give us access to technology others do not have. And our independence gives us the ability to choose only those components that provide the best value to our customers.
Dahlman works very hard to place the latest seed technologies in our product lineup. Improved genetics with useful traits help you field a great crop and generate excellent revenue. Working very hard in production and processing to handle seed with the highest possible concern for quality. Healthy seed provides excellent germination and strong early growth to start your crop right.
Mustang Seeds is a family owned, regional, independent seed company that has been serving the upper Midwest with all their seed needs since 1963. Mustang seeds is here for you and continues to strive to provide the products and traits along with the best customer service to meet their customer’s needs. Mustang seeds has a full lineup of corn, soybeans, alfalfa, grasses and cover crops.
Grain Pickup
We understand you are busy and our goal is to keep your operation doing what it does best. Allow our professional personnel to pick up and deliver stored grain directly from your farm, making your farm more efficient.
Grain Handling,
Storage & Sales
We have worked hard to create efficiencies in our systems which translate into exceptional service for you. Configured to get you in, unloaded and back out to the field in minimal time, means more efficient use of your trucks and drivers. With the addition of a new 170,000 bushel bin being added in 2012, our total storage capacity is 980,000 bushels. Because we are experts in sales, storage and transportation, we will work to get you the best price possible. Before you sell, give us a shot at earning your business.
New Offerings
Newly added to our offerings are products from Agassiz Seed & Supply including Baler Twine and Net Wrap as well as Hay and Silage Preservative.
Agassiz Seed and Supply has developed a product line specifically suited for the upper Midwest. Our business is located here, we live here, and we know what it means to have products that will perform in this environment.
Newly added to Emden Grain’s offerings are products from Pritchett Twine Net Wrap & Ag Sales, including a complete line of net wrap.
The Pritchett Twine and Netwrap Comapany has been involved with selling Quality Twine and Netwrap since the year 2000.
